capture.source: git archive of verified annotated-tag peeled commits; TypeScript transformed in memory by existing rolldown/utils
capture.goldenBytes: Unmodified emitted buffers; content-addressed deduplication changes neither bytes nor file identities. Modes record the capture filesystem, not Git checkout permission bits.
capture.authority: Offline source characterization only; no native, installed-artifact, provider, publication or release qualification.
capture.replay: Static root-bound journals are refusal fixtures outside their original roots. Positive recovery separately invokes the captured released source in a fresh private project and hands its unmodified bytes/seals to current readers at that SAME root.
capture.regeneration: Run node tests/fixtures/released-baseline/capture.mjs <NEW checkout-relative directory>. UUIDs, owner PIDs and absolute roots are intentionally not deterministic. Never overwrite this corpus or normalize new output to match it.

authority.limitations: Raw successor/history serializer output before managed-core/manifest reconciliation; not a complete active project.
